S.od.tag: Two orbits. One tap. Every jump on the beat.
S.od.lead: A rhythm arcade in deep space: one tap switches orbits, and every jump lands on the beat of our own music. Five levels, an endless mode, Orbit III and a global leaderboard.
S.od.new: Now in **82 languages**. The game picks up your phone’s language by itself. Switch any time with the globe in the settings.

S.more.title: More from Lewydo
S.more.lead: A relaxing merge puzzle, a cozy clicker and interactive guides for game developers — all on Google Play.
S.game.imc.d: Drag. Merge. Evolve. A relaxing idle merge puzzle with goals, daily rewards and endless cube progression.
S.game.joints.d: An interactive guide to Box2D joints in LibGDX, with live examples, animations and useful links. Made by a LibGDX developer for LibGDX developers.
S.game.light.d: Play with four kinds of 2D light: point, cone, chain and directional. Move the lights, cast shadows and tweak every setting.
S.game.autumn.d: A cozy autumn clicker with falling leaves, warm colors, nature sounds to unlock and leaderboards. No timers, no pressure: just tap and unwind.

S.p.vlad.who: Vlad, Android and LibGDX developer · Poltava region, Ukraine
S.p.vlad.bio: Writing code since 2017: Java first, Kotlin a year later. A full-time game developer since 2021, from trainee all the way to Team Lead at a game studio. Every Lewydo game is built with Kotlin and LibGDX, Android first.
S.p.lilya.bio: Websites, presentation design and social media visuals are her main field. Thanks to Vlad she stepped into game design too, and every Lewydo game carries her touch. *Between us: websites are still her first love* 😉
S.story.title: Our story so far
S.story.1.d: Vlad writes his first code. A year later he switches to Kotlin and stays with it for good.
S.story.2.d: Vlad leaves the Military Institute of Telecommunications behind and goes full-time into games: trainee, junior… all the way to Team Lead.
S.story.3.d: A developer meets a designer. The studio doesn't know it exists yet.
S.story.4.d: Same day, different month — a team forever.
S.story.brand.d: Vlad always ended his [Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) articles on LibGDX, Android and Kotlin the same way: «Love what you do» and a green heart 💚. That sign-off became our brand.
S.story.imc.d: IMC: Idle Merge Cubes 2026 is released on Google Play.
S.story.idea.d: Vlad is serving in the Armed Forces of Ukraine. One morning he wakes up in a house where his unit is staying on an assignment — with the idea of CubePix in his head.
S.story.od.d: We make Orbit Dash and publish it on Google Play: two orbits, one tap.
S.story.proto.d: The first playable prototype: famous paintings revealed cube by cube.
S.story.pix.d: We invent the CubePix mascot: a little pink painter cube with a beret and a brush. His name is Pix — Cube + Pix = CubePix, so the game carries his name.
S.story.live.d: Andrii (TikTok @malcev_ua) plays Orbit Dash in a TikTok LIVE — the first streamer ever to go live with our game.
S.story.live.video: Andrii plays Orbit Dash live on TikTok
S.story.live.thanks: Thank you, Andrii, for being my first streamer to go live playing my game. Thank you so much!
S.story.next.d: Coming this month — the exact date very soon.

S.cp:tagline: REVEAL THE PICTURE CUBE BY CUBE
S.cp:lead: A calm puzzle for art lovers. Fill the cubes layer by layer, and famous paintings, wonders of the world and little pixel treasures come to life. Every picture ends with a museum label and a true story.
S.cp:about: Lewydo is a two-person indie game studio from Ukraine. Vlad codes, Lilya designs. Together we make the games we love to play.
S.cp:how: Your cube shows a number. Tap the cells with the same number, or swipe across them in one long chain: chains score more.
S.cp:demo: A painting from the museum, revealed layer by layer
S.cp:pixName: He’s a cube, and his name is Pix. Put the two together and you get CubePix: the game carries his name.

strawberry.f: A strawberry isn’t a true berry: each tiny “seed” on it is a separate fruit with a seed inside.
